changelog: React Bits SpotlightCard Component: ported interactive radial spotlight and border edge-catch illumination to native Jetpack Compose with zero-jank 120 FPS draw phase rendering
Interactive Accounts Spotlight Cards: configured accounts now feature touch-following light tracking, emerald glow on active accounts, and titanium accents on inactive accounts
3-Stat Real-Time Overview: displays real-time Status (Active now vs last used relative time), Prompt Credits count, and Flow / Plan Tier in a sleek pill container
Global react-bits Skill: integrated global Antigravity skill for automated React Bits JSON registry queries and Compose translations without workspace pollution
